run_query: run the query function to send an image to a Replicate FLUX model for image-to-image generation
create_query_function: create a query function that reads an image file, base64-encodes it, and posts it to a Replicate API endpoint
test_query_function: test the query function with a prompt and image path to generate an image-to-image transformation
refactor_query_function: refactor the query function to accept multiple input image paths and return decoded PIL Image objects
review_query_function: review the query function that encodes images as base64 and sends POST requests to the Replicate predictions API
